DRAMET1.sensitivity: inside a nonflat table segment and away from gwl=0, dq/dgwl = sign(gwl)*dq/d|gwl|; outside table range derivative is zero because AFGEN clamps to endpoint values
nonsmooth_sets: table knots with unequal adjacent slopes
gwl=0 when first active table slope is nonzero
DRAMET1.migration_note: AFGEN semantics are adapter/shared interpolation semantics and should not be hidden inside drainage state

DRAMET2.legacy_law: diffl=(gwl-zbotdr)/shape; if diffl<1e-10 then q=0 else q=diffl/R_total
DRAMET2.sensitivity_form: dq/dgwl = ((1/shape)*R_total - diffl*dR_total/dgwl)/(R_total^2) on a stable active branch
nonsmooth_sets: IPOS=4 at gwl=zintf when kvtop differs from kvbot
equivalent-depth internal branch x=0.5 and x=1e-6 are formula branches requiring continuity checks
domain_findings: legacy reader permits zero khtop/khbot/kvtop/kvbot in ranges although selected formulas may divide by them
legacy reader permits wetper=0 although log(L/wetper) or log(dbot/wetper) may be evaluated
IPOS=5 permits geofac=0 although log(geofac*(zbotdr-zintf)/wetper) may be evaluated
DRAMET2.migration_note: production migration needs explicit mathematically valid parameter-domain checks; do not silently rely on floating exceptions

DRAMET3_INTERFLOW.legacy_law: q = cofintfl*diffl^expintfl for the highest drainage level when interflow is enabled and diffl>=0
DRAMET3_INTERFLOW.activation_finding: for every admitted expintfl<1 the right-hand derivative diverges as diffl approaches zero from above; at expintfl=1 it is finite
DRAMET3_INTERFLOW.migration_note: a fully implicit production path cannot assume a bounded tangent at activation; branch-aware fallback/frozen evaluation is required unless separately qualified

DRAMET3_MULTILEVEL.legacy_law: evaluate each drainage level against shared gwl and level-specific resolved drain/control head, then aggregate
DRAMET3_MULTILEVEL.state: none when control levels are external
DRAMET3_MULTILEVEL.sensitivity: on a stable branch, derivative of total exchange with respect to gwl is the sum of the admitted per-level derivatives
DRAMET3_MULTILEVEL.nonsmooth_sets: union of all level activation/deactivation and interflow branch points
DRAMET3_MULTILEVEL.architecture: per-level exchange objects remain independent physical transfers; aggregation is composition, not shared hidden process state

recommended_child_split: F-PM08C1: AFGEN-backed tabulated response semantics and derivative metadata
F-PM08C2: Hooghoudt/Ernst IPOS 1..5 response and analytic sensitivity qualification
F-PM08C3: empirical interflow singular-tangent policy qualification
F-PM08C4: multi-level exchange aggregation and branch-composition qualification
